title: PDF documents (.pdf)
summary: Multi-page documents; a page is drawn as an image. There is no diagnostics channel.

items.text: Pages: --page N (from 1) or --all-pages; the page rotation is applied.

Embedding: <image href="report.pdf#page=3" .../> in an SVG file draws page 3 (page 1 without the fragment); a page that does not exist is image-page-out-of-range. See 'canvasnet help svg'. On the command line the same fragment on the input chooses the page: canvasnet render "report.pdf#page=3" -o p3.png (it overrides --page; a page that does not exist is page-out-of-range).
Resolution: --dpi, default 96, at most {{maxDpi}}.
Paths, fills, strokes, clipping, and images (resampled once to the size they cover).
Color spaces Device, Cal, Lab, ICCBased (chosen by component count; the profile is not applied), Indexed, Separation, DeviceN, and Pattern.
Axial, radial, and mesh shadings (types 2 to 7) and tiling patterns.

Text with simple TrueType fonts. An embedded font is used; a font that is not embedded is substituted silently by an installed font, else by the bundled Liberation fonts (Symbol and ZapfDingbats use bundled Noto fonts).

These make the page fail with unsupported-feature, with or without --strict, and no partial picture is written: MMType1 fonts, function-based shadings (type 1), transparency groups, Type 3 glyphs under a text clip mode, and symbolic fonts that are not embedded and have no substitute.
An image in a Lab color space with a Decode array.
A DeviceN image with more distinct pixels than the tint-evaluation budget allows.
ICC profile data is ignored silently.
The tool has no option to supply a password, a font folder, or a page range other than one page or all pages.
The page to draw, counted from 1 (default 1); a page beyond the last is page-out-of-range.
Draw every page; for a document of more than one page the output must contain {page} or be a directory.
Resolution in dots per inch (default 96, above 0 and at most {{maxDpi}}). A 72 by 48 point page is 96 by 64 pixels at 96 dpi.
Multiply the natural size by a factor; --width, --height, and --size also size the page.
The color the page is flattened over (white by default).
Accepted, but PDF has no diagnostics channel, so it changes nothing.
None: the diagnostics[] list of a PDF is always empty and --strict has no effect. A feature the renderer cannot draw is an error instead.
Error code: the message names the feature, for example pdf-image-lab-decode or pdf-image-tint-budget.
Error code: a damaged or truncated document.
Error code: --page is beyond the last page.
ICC profiles are not applied, so colors in ICCBased spaces can differ slightly from a viewer.
A substituted font is chosen from the installed fonts, so text with fonts that are not embedded can differ between machines.
Mesh shadings in DeviceCMYK, Separation, and DeviceN spaces are approximated: each vertex is converted to RGB first and the result is blended.
Images are resampled once, so thin one pixel rules are attenuated rather than dropped.
